findings.title: The delegate-worker environment boundary lacks real child-process coverage
findings.trigger: The detached delegate-worker spawn environment regresses to process.env while the final ACP and CLI Host layers continue to filter their own environments.
findings.impact: Primary controls or unrelated provider secrets can reach the real worker process while all current environment tests remain green, so D1R-01 and D1-AC01 are not fully protected at the required four process seams.
findings.evidence: The current test at lines 1399-1446 checks only the derived envViews.worker object. The process-level tests capture the probe and ACP Host at lines 1465-1544 and the CLI Host at lines 1554-1589, but no fixture observes the actual detached delegate-worker launched by delegate.cjs lines 1092-1099.
findings.suggestion: Add one minimal real worker key-capture fixture that observes the spawned delegate-worker, proves only that worker receives the three packet path keys, and proves Primary and unrelated-secret keys and canary values are absent.
